Hi All,


I’m calculating an average of two estimates, weighted by effort, using the formula from ‘Introduction to Distance Sampling’, Section 8.5, equations 8.7 and 8.8.  I also need to calculate the degrees of freedom for the same average. Do I use the same df formula that is appropriate for adding estimates, based on the Satterthwaite procedure?  I’ve edited the df calculation to match equations 8.7 and 8.8 and included it here (see image).  Since equations 8.7 and 8.8 are weighting the estimate by effort, is it appropriate to also weight the df calculation by effort as well? 


Thanks for the comments,
